in_marathi.name: Gunjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gunjan in Sanskrit language is derived from the word 'Gun' which means sound and 'Jan' which means born. This name signifies the sound of creation, the birth of the universe, and the divine melody that resonates in every living being.
